# Ravomix

> Free toolkit with 200+ document templates (application letters, complaint letters, legal & finance forms) and 50+ utility tools. Hindi & English. No login required.

Ravomix helps students, professionals, business owners, lawyers and CAs in India generate ready-to-use letters and run everyday calculations directly in the browser, with offline support and a free Android app.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of templates and tools.
- [Applications](/applications): 120+ application letter templates (school, college, office, bank, government, legal).
- [Complaints](/complaints): 80+ complaint letter templates (housing, banking, public utility, consumer, travel).
- [Tools](/tools): 50+ free calculators and converters (EMI, GST, income tax, BMI, unit & currency converters).
- [Guide](/guide): Step-by-step articles on writing applications, complaints and legal documents.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about using Ravomix.
- [About](/about): What Ravomix is and who builds it.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Ravomix team.
- [Install](/install): Install the Android app or PWA.
